source_id: scenario_universe_21_5e0gvz (GAIA2 adaptability trial used as the worked example in Appendix A.1 / Figure 10 of arXiv 2609.13463; NOT one of the 50 unreleased MegaRCA-Mix trials)
task: Cancel the user's Saturday appointments and schedule a 'Film Production Day' event with a friend. Reschedule based on the friend's reply; if the friend cannot make it and proposes no alternative, cancel the plan.
final_output: Agent finalised after a single short wait returned no reply from the friend, without rescheduling or cancelling as instructed (task failed the GAIA2 verifier).

steps.content: Action: cancel the user's Saturday appointments and send the friend a message proposing the 'Film Production Day' event. (Reconstructed from the paper's prose; the paper does not print the raw turns.)
Action: set up a trigger gated on a message-count check and issue one short wait (about 180 simulated seconds) for the friend's reply.
Observation: the wait returns after roughly 3 real seconds with no notifications; the environment's notification/settings state is empty (config.json / console log show empty environment settings).
Thought/Action: no reply observed, conclude there is nothing further to do and finish the task without rescheduling or cancelling.

annotation.category: edge=model–external environment; fault_side=environment; failure_mode=Stale State Delivery
annotation.reason: The environment reported a healthy, completed wait but delivered stale/empty state (no notifications), so the agent's belief that the friend had not replied was induced by the environment rather than by the model cutting scope. A trajectory-only reading (judge turn 2) wrongly blamed the model ('Satisficing'); opening config.json and the console log (judge turn 3) revealed the empty environment settings and corrected the attribution.

extra.taxonomy: Interaction-centric taxonomy of Raj et al. 2026 (arXiv 2607.28802): 41 failure modes, each tied to an edge between the model and another component (owner, grader, third party, context, memory, tool, peer/subagent model, local/external environment) and a fault side (model | harness | environment | grader).
extra.label_format_megarca_mix: gold = set(s) of acceptable taxonomy clusters + first-divergence citation; scored by max-over-gold-sets set-F1 per trial, averaged over 50 trials
